name: maintenance
description: Use when a symptom could come from skipped servicing (oil, filters, timing belt, coolant, brake fluid, DPF) or the user asks what is due.
instructions: Call read_maintenance {} once: it lists this car's service items worst first with status, last service date and km, and the km / days left (or overdue).
The logbook is what the user entered on this phone for this car only; an item that reads 'never logged' may well have been done elsewhere, so ask before calling it overdue.
When the odometer is not entered, only the days left are known: suggest entering the current km in Maintenance.
interpret: Status soon: within 10 % of the km interval (at least 500 km) or within 30 days; overdue: past the km or the time interval, whichever comes first.
Overdue engine oil and filter on a diesel can show as low oil pressure warnings, higher soot load and a DPF that fills faster.
An overdue fuel filter (diesel) fits hard starting, loss of power under load and rail pressure deviation codes (P0087, P0093).
An overdue air filter fits low MAF readings and a lazy turbo; an overdue timing belt is a breakdown risk: tell the user plainly, never as a cause of a code.
Old brake fluid and coolant are time-based items: they do not set engine codes, but overdue coolant fits overheating and heater complaints.
